package protocoldef

//roost:proto package=game.protocol go_package=GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb;pb

type CoopViewRequest struct {
	RoomID int64 `pb:"1"`
}
type CoopViewResponse struct {
	Code     int32  `pb:"1"`
	Revision uint64 `pb:"2"`
	NextSeq  uint64 `pb:"3"`
	Stage    int32  `pb:"4"`
	Cleared  bool   `pb:"5"`
	Claimed  bool   `pb:"6"`
	Coins    int64  `pb:"7"`
}
type CoopViewProtocol interface {
	//roost:msg id=15002 tags=local
	CoopView(CoopViewRequest) CoopViewResponse
}
